description: Path records are numbers whose trajectory reaches a higher maximum than any smaller number. The expansion X_2(n) = Mx(n)/n^2 is key. Current record: X_2 ~ 16.3. Open Question: is X_2 bounded?
mathematical_formalization: Mx(n) >= n * (3/2)^{v(n)} where v(n) is longest initial odd run. X_Q(n) = Mx(n)/n^Q is unbounded for Q < log(3)/log(2) ~ 1.585 but may be bounded for Q >= 2.
analogical_connections: Maximum displacement of biased random walk
Maximum flood height in hydrology (first-passage problem)
Stock price all-time highs with fat-tailed distributions
implementation_hypothesis: Fast path record finder with 128-bit arithmetic. Early abort if Mx(n) can be bounded below existing record.
experiment_seed: Search for X_2(n) > 16.4 in range [10^18, 10^20] using binary template sieve.
